note: Named Central Hub NPCs, presentation only: three OpenTrident MakeHuman V2 bodies on the 106-joint Mixamo rig with their 12 clips replaced by ONE retargeted Mixamo idle each (art/hub-npcs/build.mjs), registered in assets/manifest-hollow.json as deferred rows (a row's ref is its manifest model id). engine/hub-npcs.js draws them in `area` while the player is there and removes them on leaving. They are not entities: no health, collision, targeting, trade, healing, quest or save state, so no cash, inventory or save record is touched. Placement is painting fractions (x right, y down, like the layout and exits) projected on the ground; facingDegrees turns the body about the vertical (0 faces the camera); phaseSeconds offsets each idle so they do not move together; idleRate scales the idle clock (1 is the clip's own speed). The code drives the idle itself because DonorMotion holds a standing human at phase 0. scaleFallback is the scale used when a manifest row or the caller gives none. enabled false or ?nonpcs=1 removes them. bodySha256 is the sha256 of OpenTrident's delivered body (art/hub-npcs/assets.json); the shipped file differs only by its clip.
